Wrongly Paid Service Tax cannot be taken as CENVAT Credit Suo Moto, Can Only seek Refund: Madras HC [Read Order]

Proper procedure is to seek refund of the excess tax paid. The remedy is to file a refund claim under Section 11-B of the Central Excise Act, 1944, not taking suo moto credit, observed the bench.

External source Taxscan 9 Jul 2026, 1:11 pm 1 min brief
